notLevied.why: 4200: no net wealth tax: Constitution of the Kingdom of Morocco (2011) art. 39: all bear the public charges which only the law may create and apportion; art. 71: the fiscal regime, the base, rate and collection of imposts are of the domain of the law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Morocco_2011.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Code général des impôts 2025 (IS, IR, TVA, droits d'enregistrement, taxe spéciale annuelle sur les véhicules), dahir 1-77-340 (TIC). convention R5-3k-G (extended in pass 3l to states without a closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3l).
